One moderator decision on Mastodon can cut off an entire server. In our new #CSCW2026 paper, we analyzed 1,800+ instances and found only 20% share their blocklists—and even fewer explain why.
Interviews with 12 moderators reveal tensions around openness, proactive safety, and nuanced moderation work as well as highlight opportunities to better support transparency and deliberation.

 w/ @s0hw @YuhanLiu @manoel @andresmh
